CLASS_MAP_extension.scope: SLoPP/SLoPP-E nitrile references: polyacrylonitrile 13 + ABS family 11
CLASS_MAP_extension.reason: The corresponding class carries a single diagnostic key band (2240 cm-1). The ranking rule needs at least two key bands even for a tentative call, so the class can never leave "unresolved" and the evidence floor withholds it in every case. Mapping would extend stream 2 vocabulary without changing the band-library output.

name_to_class_mapping.scope: translation of tool names onto a common chemical vocabulary
name_to_class_mapping.reason: A mapping table is an author assumption and it shrinks the divergence being measured. Group-structure measures (purity, completeness, ARI) need no shared vocabulary.
name_to_class_mapping.note: Stream 2 returns band-library classes because its reference spectra were assigned to them before matching (Code 1 CLASS_MAP, Section 12-4); no stream output is translated after matching.
